title: Login History keeps sessions "Active" after they expire

panels.caption: Login History → status Active: 255 sessions, many weeks old

Zoho: Active Sessions are current sign-ins; online = active on the web now
text: Zoho Accounts → Sessions → Active Sessions lists the sessions that are currently signed in (device, browser, location); a session can be ended from there.
Zoho CRM assignment rules: "An online user is one that is online on web. There will be maximum of 5 mins delay in fetching online users status."
